description: Full-text search across ASX announcement filings, returning snippets of what filings say - commentary, explanations and wording - rather than structured figures. Suited to questions about specific disclosure language where no structured field covers it. Each call costs 1 credit. Queries of 2-5 keywords work best; a longer query that matches nothing is retried once with its key terms, and the response says so. Results carry doc_keys, which identify filings that filing_text reads in full. If a response has truncated=true the match pool was larger than the page: narrower parameters are symbol, match='phrase' for exact disclosure language, and the event, types and date bounds. Structured numbers for one company are in company_events.

event.description: Optional known announcement kind (suspension, takeover, guidance_revision, capital_raise, buyback, distress, trading_update, consolidation) — event matching bypasses text ranking entirely.

priceSensitive.description: Optional: only price-sensitive filings, or only not.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'share purchase plan' or 'BHM'.

tier.description: Optional: T1 (market-moving only), T2, or T3.

types.description: Optional comma-separated ASX announcement types, e.g. 'Appendix 3Y,Appendix 4C'.

name: search_filings
title: Search filings
